How we work

We support every election from start to finish.

Our model combines proprietary technology, field implementation and institutional support.

Working model

Five stages, one accountable team.

  1. Assessment

    Together with the electoral body, we review the legal framework, calendar and logistics of the process.

  2. Configuration

    We configure each solution to the rules, ballots and districts of the election.

  3. Training

    We train polling officials, technicians and voters with in-person and online tools.

  4. Election day

    We deploy equipment and field support, with centralized real-time monitoring.

  5. Results and audit

    We tabulate and publish results with full traceability, available for audit.

Why Comitia

Technology built for real-world elections.

We work with governments and electoral bodies, adapting each solution to the legal framework, logistics and specific challenges of every process.

Platforms built for real-world contexts

Designed to work in the field, with the connectivity, climate and scale each election day demands.

Implementation and institutional support

We support electoral authorities before, during and after the election, with training and on-site assistance.

Security, traceability and real-time data

Every stage is recorded and auditable. Information reaches the people who need it, when they need it.
